label: XCOM 2 sandboxes
description: How XCOM 2 sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Each mod is a folder ending in a .XComMod file. War of the Chosen keeps its own copy of the game under XCom2-WarOfTheChosen, with its own Mods folder (the second target); this rule installs into the base one. Steam Workshop subscriptions are Steam's business and are not touched.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
